finding_text_ko: 벌크 의약품, 공정 중 의약품, 원료 또는 포장재에 필요한 정보가 모두 표시되어 있지 않았다. 제조공정·설비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지·관리가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토에 대한 평가·문서화 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate. The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 설비의 예방정비(preventative maintenance) 및 수리가 미흡했다. 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.

finding_text: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.

finding_text: Complete testing was not performed according to the requirements.
finding_text_ko: 요구사항에 따른 전항목 시험이 수행되지 않았다.

finding_text: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정(calibration)·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The company's investigations of microbial contamination in critical areas were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 청정구역(critical area)에서 발생한 미생물 오염에 대한 회사의 조사가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.
finding_text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보증하기에 미흡했다.

finding_text: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate. The quality control department did not evaluate the results of the annual product quality review.
finding_text_ko: 연간제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 연간제품품질평가 결과를 평가하지 않았다.

finding_text: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).
finding_text_ko: 수입자가, 의약품의 제조·포장/표시 또는 시험에 이용하는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080) 에 규정된 요건을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다.

finding_text: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 공급자·제조업자·시험기관·포장업자·표시업자·유통업자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지·관리가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 공급자·제조업자·시험기관·포장업자·표시업자·유통업자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지·관리가 미흡했다.

finding_text: Yields and/or the reconciled quantities were not checked at appropriate stages.
finding_text_ko: 수율 및/또는 수불 대조 수량이 적절한 단계에서 확인되지 않았다.

finding_text: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 학력·경력 및/또는 감독이 미흡했다.

finding_text: The sampling procedure was inadequate for microbiological monitoring in processing areas or aseptic areas. In areas where aseptic operations were performed, the frequency and the methods of monitoring were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 제조구역 또는 무균구역의 미생물 모니터링을 위한 검체 채취 절차가 미흡했다. 무균공정(aseptic) 작업이 수행되는 구역에서 모니터링의 주기와 방법이 미흡했다.

finding_text: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지·관리가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The aseptic process simulation study was not long enough to cover all routine manipulations, normal interventions, and worst case situations.
finding_text_ko: 무균공정 모의시험(aseptic process simulation)의 수행 시간이 모든 통상 조작, 정상 개입(intervention) 및 최악 조건 상황을 포괄하기에 충분히 길지 않았다.

finding_text: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The written self-inspection procedure was inadequate. The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 문서화된 자체점검(self-inspection) 절차가 미흡했다. 자체점검 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.

finding_text: The company's cleaning of the premises and the equipment in aseptic areas was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 무균구역의 시설 및 설비에 대한 회사의 청소가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.

finding_text: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.

finding_text: Senior management's ability to determine and/or provide adequate and/or appropriate resources to implement, maintain and/or improve the effectiveness of the quality management system was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 품질경영시스템(quality management system)의 실행·유지 및/또는 효과성 개선에 필요한 적절하고 적합한 자원을 파악 및/또는 제공하는 최고경영진의 역량이 미흡했다.

finding_text: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate. The maintenance of records was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다. 기록의 유지·관리가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The maintenance of records was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 기록의 유지·관리가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The segregation, rotation of stock, and/or the transportation of raw materials, packaging materials, intermediates, bulk drugs, and/or finished products was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 원료·포장재·중간제품·벌크 의약품 및/또는 완제품의 구획 분리, 재고 순환(rotation of stock) 및/또는 운송이 미흡했다.

finding_text: No deficiencies were recorded.
finding_text_ko: 기록된 지적사항이 없었다.

finding_text: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정(calibration)·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
